verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ אִ֥ישׁ מֵֽהַר־ אֶפְרָ֖יִם וּשְׁמ֥וֹ מִיכָֽיְהוּ׃
verses.literal: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: E HAVIA um homem da montanha de Efraim, cujo nome era Mica.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִמּ֡וֹ אֶלֶף֩ וּמֵאָ֨ה הַכֶּ֜סֶף אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֻֽקַּֽח־ לָ֗ךְ וְאַתִּי אָלִית֙ וְגַם֙ אָמַ֣רְתְּ בְּאָזְנַ֔י הִנֵּֽה־ הַכֶּ֥סֶף אִתִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י לְקַחְתִּ֑יו וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִמּ֔וֹ בָּר֥וּךְ בְּנִ֖י לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·’im·mōw ’e·lep̄ ū·mê·’āh hak·ke·sep̄ ’ă·šer luq·qaḥ- lāḵ wə·ʾat·tī ’ā·lîṯ wə·ḡam ’ā·mart bə·’ā·zə·nay hin·nêh- hak·ke·sep̄ ’it·tî ’ă·nî lə·qaḥ·tîw wat·tō·mer ’im·mōw bā·rūḵ bə·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: said to his mother The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse I have the silver here with me I took it Then his mother said Blessed be my son by the LORD
verses.literalPt: O qual disse à sua mãe: As mil e cem moedas de prata que te foram tiradas, por cuja causa lançaste maldições, e de que também me falaste, eis que esse dinheiro está comigo; eu o tomei. Então lhe disse sua mãe: Bendito do SENHOR seja meu filho.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׁב אֶת־ אֶֽלֶף־ וּמֵאָ֥ה הַכֶּ֖סֶף לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִמּ֡וֹ הַקְדֵּ֣שׁ הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־ הַכֶּסֶף֩ לַיהוָ֨ה מִיָּדִ֜י לִבְנִ֗י לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֔ה וְעַתָּ֖ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- ’e·lep̄- ū·mê·’āh hak·ke·sep̄ lə·’im·mōw wat·tō·mer ’im·mōw haq·dêš hiq·daš·tî ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ Yah·weh mî·yā·ḏî liḇ·nî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: And when he had returned . . . the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother she said I wholly dedicate . . . the silver to the LORD . . . for my son’s benefit to make a graven image and a molten idol Therefore I will now return it to you
verses.literalPt: Assim restituiu as mil e cem moedas de prata à sua mãe; porém sua mãe disse: Inteiramente tenho dedicado este dinheiro da minha mão ao SENHOR, para meu filho fazer uma imagem de escultura e uma de fundição; de sorte que agora to tornarei a dar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַתִּקַּ֣ח אִמּוֹ֩ מָאתַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף וַתִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ לַצּוֹרֵ֗ף וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֔ה וַיְהִ֖י בְּבֵ֥ית מִיכָֽיְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ lə·’im·mōw wat·tiq·qaḥ ’im·mōw mā·ṯa·yim ke·sep̄ wat·tit·tə·nê·hū laṣ·ṣō·w·rêp̄ way·ya·‘ă·śê·hū pe·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh way·hî bə·ḇêṯ mî·ḵā·yə·hū
verses.literal: So he returned the silver to his mother and she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith who made them into a graven image and a molten idol And they were placed in the house of Micah
verses.literalPt: Porém ele restituiu aquele dinheiro à sua mãe; e sua mãe tomou duzentas moedas de prata, e as deu ao ourives, o qual fez delas uma imagem de escultura e uma de fundição, que ficaram em casa de Mica.

verses.original: וְהָאִ֣ישׁ מִיכָ֔ה ל֖וֹ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֵפוֹד֙ וּתְרָפִ֔ים וַיְמַלֵּ֗א אֶת־ יַ֤ד אַחַד֙ מִבָּנָ֔יו וַיְהִי־ ל֖וֹ לְכֹהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš mî·ḵāh lōw bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ya·‘aś ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ ū·ṯə·rā·p̄îm way·mal·lê ’eṯ- yaḏ ’a·ḥaḏ mib·bā·nāw way·hî- lōw lə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: Now this man Micah had a shrine . . . and he made an ephod and some household idols and ordained - one of his sons as his priest
verses.literalPt: E teve este homem, Mica, uma casa de deuses; e fez um éfode e terafins, e consagrou um de seus filhos, para que lhe fosse por sacerdote.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֛ישׁ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ’ên me·leḵ bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’îš hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nāw ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: In those days there was no king in Israel everyone did what was right in his own eyes
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias não havia rei em Israel; cada um fazia o que parecia bem aos seus olhos.

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ נַ֗עַר מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְה֥וּא לֵוִ֖י וְה֥וּא גָֽר־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- na·‘ar mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·hū lê·wî wə·hū ḡār- šām
verses.literal: And there was a young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who had been residing . . . within the clan of Judah
verses.literalPt: E havia um moço de Belém de Judá, da tribo de Judá, que era levita, e peregrinava ali.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הָאִ֜ישׁ מֵהָעִ֗יר מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה לָג֖וּר בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יִמְצָ֑א וַיָּבֹ֧א הַר־ אֶפְרַ֛יִם עַד־ בֵּ֥ית מִיכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ hā·’îš mê·hā·‘îr mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh lā·ḡūr ba·’ă·šer yim·ṣā way·yā·ḇō har- ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘aḏ- bêṯ mî·ḵāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ dar·kōw
verses.literal: This man left the city of Bethlehem in Judah to settle where he could find a place And as he traveled . . . he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: E este homem partiu da cidade de Belém de Judá para peregrinar onde quer que achasse conveniente. Chegando ele, pois, à montanha de Efraim, até à casa de Mica, seguindo o seu caminho,

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ מִיכָ֖ה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לֵוִ֣י אָנֹ֗כִי מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאָנֹכִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ לָג֖וּר בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer- lōw mî·ḵāh mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō·w way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lê·wî ’ā·nō·ḵî mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hō·lêḵ lā·ḡūr ba·’ă·šer ’em·ṣā
verses.literal: Where are you from Micah asked him I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah he replied . . . and I am on my way to settle wherever I can find a place
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Mica: Donde vens? E ele lhe disse: Sou levita de Belém de Judá, e vou peregrinar onde quer que achar conveniente.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ מִיכָ֜ה שְׁבָ֣ה עִמָּדִ֗י וֶֽהְיֵה־ לִי֮ לְאָ֣ב וּלְכֹהֵן֒ וְאָנֹכִ֨י אֶֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֜ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לַיָּמִ֔ים וְעֵ֥רֶךְ בְּגָדִ֖ים וּמִחְיָתֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ הַלֵּוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw mî·ḵāh šə·ḇāh ‘im·mā·ḏî weh·yêh- lî lə·’āḇ ū·lə·ḵō·hên wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’et·ten- lə·ḵā ‘ă·śe·reṯ ke·sep̄ lay·yā·mîm wə·‘ê·reḵ bə·ḡā·ḏîm ū·miḥ·yā·ṯe·ḵā way·yê·leḵ hal·lê·wî
verses.literal: Stay with me Micah said to him and be my father and priest and I will give you ten shekels of silver per year a suit of clothes and your provisions So the Levite went in
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse Mica: Fica comigo, e sê-me por pai e sacerdote; e cada ano te darei dez moedas de prata, e vestuário, e o sustento. E o levita entrou.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹאֶל הַלֵּוִ֖י לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיְהִ֤י הַנַּ֙עַר֙ ל֔וֹ כְּאַחַ֖ד מִבָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·’el hal·lê·wî lā·še·ḇeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’îš way·hî han·na·‘ar lōw kə·’a·ḥaḏ mib·bā·nāw
verses.literal: and agreed . . . to stay with him and the young man became like a son to Micah
verses.literalPt: E consentiu o levita em ficar com aquele homem; e o moço lhe foi como um de seus filhos.

verses.original: וַיְמַלֵּ֤א מִיכָה֙ אֶת־ יַ֣ד הַלֵּוִ֔י וַיְהִי־ ל֥וֹ הַנַּ֖עַר לְכֹהֵ֑ן וַיְהִ֖י בְּבֵ֥ית מִיכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·mal·lê mî·ḵāh ’eṯ- yaḏ hal·lê·wî way·hî- lōw han·na·‘ar lə·ḵō·hên way·hî bə·ḇêṯ mî·ḵāh
verses.literal: Micah ordained . . . the Levite and the young man became his priest and lived in his house
verses.literalPt: E Mica consagrou o levita, e aquele moço lhe foi por sacerdote; e esteve em casa de Mica.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי־ יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה לִ֑י כִּ֧י הָיָה־ לִ֛י הַלֵּוִ֖י לְכֹהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mî·ḵāh ‘at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- yê·ṭîḇ Yah·weh lî kî hā·yāh- lî hal·lê·wî lə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: Then Micah said Now I know that the LORD will be good to me because a Levite has become my priest
verses.literalPt: Então disse Mica: Agora sei que o SENHOR me fará bem; porquanto tenho um levita por sacerdote.
